subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Should the repository accept the intentional breaking reshapes of the question, worker, and session-catalog protocol surfaces before public npm publication?
rationale: The branch is intentionally changing compatibility-sensitive gateway and plugin-SDK contracts based on a claimed shipped-surface audit; that product and release-boundary acceptance cannot be inferred from code review alone.

options.title: Accept the pre-publication cleanup
options.body: Approve the stated unshipped/beta compatibility boundary after reviewing final-head runtime proof and the shipped-surface audit.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Retain legacy protocol shapes or add a documented migration path for any consumers maintainers consider supported.

recommendation.title: Accept the pre-publication cleanup
recommendation.body: Approve the stated unshipped/beta compatibility boundary after reviewing final-head runtime proof and the shipped-surface audit.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies steipete as the recent contributor who assembled the protocol audit and the affected contract changes.
